svg.title: UML class diagram of Simulation.py
svg.text: Host-side driver. Recorder classes capture your script; run(sim) builds the case folder, drives SALOME and OpenFOAM, and returns an OpenFOAMCase.
patch name → inline values (T_Face, T_Flow, V_Flow)
first line: import GeoMesh as nemos
recording — called by the recorder objects
strips inline BC keys, records 'x = nemos.Room(...)'
Two ways to feed a Simulation:
• Recording (user_script_path=None, as in the examples): every recorder call is appended to
• Script mode (user_script_path set): read_user_script() parses the script text and its simulation_config dict
• Every geometry object needs name=. It becomes the OpenFOAM patch name and the key of
